import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

architectures = ['NORA', 'TracVLA', 'OpenVLA']
trained_frac =  [0.813, 0.906, 0.719]
reference_frac = [0.844, 1.000, 0.813]
trained_labels = ['13/16', '29/32', '23/32']
reference_labels = ['13.5/16', '32/32', '26/32']

y = np.arange(len(architectures))
bar_height = 0.35

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 2.5))

bars_ref = ax.barh(y + bar_height/2, reference_frac, bar_height, label='Reference', color='#56B4E9', zorder=2)
bars_tr  = ax.barh(y - bar_height/2, trained_frac, bar_height, label='Trained', color='#0072B2', zorder=2)

# annotations
for bar, label in zip(bars_tr, trained_labels):
    ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            label, va='center', ha='left', fontsize=7.5, color='#0072B2')
for bar, label in zip(bars_ref, reference_labels):
    ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.015, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
            label, va='center', ha='left', fontsize=7.5, color='#56B4E9')

# threshold line
ax.axvline(x=0.5, color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

ax.set_xlim(0, 1.12)
ax.set_xticks([0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0])
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels(architectures)
ax.set_xlabel('Fraction of instruction-dominant heads')
ax.legend(loc='lower right', frameon=False, fontsize=8)

plt.savefig('/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_l1_attention.pdf')
print('DONE')
PYEOF
